description.value:
The runes worked into your Cloth resonate with a technique you have mastered.

Choose one Technique you know. The fundamental and property runes on your Cloth also apply to that Technique's spell attack rolls and damage, treating it as though it were a weapon bearing those runes. If the Technique makes a spell attack, it now adds your Cloth's potency bonus to that attack roll, closing the usual gap between Strikes and Techniques for this one Technique.

You may retrain this feat to choose a different Technique whenever you gain a level.
